cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Reopen the First Reason
cards.instruction: Keep them present by returning to the first reason for staying and revealing that it now means something different.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Stay until the tea cools. You always rush goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then I wasn't really waiting for the tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A goodbye that doesn't sound like you're already somewhere else. Have another sip.

mechanism: A controls the terms of departure, reopening the stated reason for staying until it reveals the personal test A actually intended.
confusable: Distinguish generic delaying from returning to tea cooling or key return and making its significance change within this interaction.
comparison: Tea delay asks for an attentive goodbye; key return tests whether a departing person will still choose a visit.
seedUse: Read canonical tea and key scenes as emotional seeds; use S01 to set departure terms rather than obscure vulnerability with generic prefixes.
